findings.summary: crates/server/tests/metrics.rs:39-41: age is only checked as >= 0 and < 5, so a gauge stuck at 0 passes (observed: replacing ages() with constant 0.0 left the test green). Nothing checks that age grows, or that a source with no good read reports a growing age. I verified both end to end only.

crates/server/src/linear.rs:38 / board.rs: two configured repos that point at the same Linear project put each ticket on the board twice. Observed: TRU-8 appeared twice, once per repo name, in the snapshot. Config loading doesn't reject or merge duplicate projects.
crates/server/src/board.rs:38,47: tickets and sub-tickets are sorted as strings, so TRU-10..TRU-14 come before TRU-9 (seen in the snapshot and the app).

board.toml configures only the Booking project, so a local run with it shows only TRU-5 (the only open Booking ticket today). The ticket's end-to-end example of 'TRU-5 to TRU-8' only holds when the 'SDLC board' project is added to the config. Linear state has also moved: TRU-6 and TRU-7 are Done.

crates/server/src/linear.rs:41: MAX_PAGES caps a project at 1000 open tickets. Pages after that are dropped with no log line or error, so the board would look complete when it isn't (inspection only).
